# git: alias: refactor alias.force and alias.please

Part of [[DOT-354]]: move [git_force](../../bin/git_force) and [git_please](../../bin/git_please) into `bin/lib/git/sync.bash` as `git-force`/`git-please`, register them as `!@ git-force` / `!@ git-please`, and decide whether `git force` (a plain `push -f`) should survive at all next to `git please` (`--force-with-lease`).

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/356#issuecomment-5711699702
Code vs intent: `git_force` and `git_please all` call `git current` (`symbolic-ref --short HEAD`), which fails on a detached HEAD / worktree edge cases that `git-push` was fixed for in 2025 (`branch --show-current`). `git force` still defaults to `all` remotes with plain `-f` — no lease — which is the "rationality" question the ticket raises.
-->
